content: Jesús vichasara vuryi̱mu̱tyi̱si̱ Ju̱denu mo̱mu vurye̱ntyutyasa̱daju̱

Vuryi̱tay jirya datyadodata jiryatiy savichasara Jesús vuryeyada rá̱ñu, ni̱tiy ma̱sasara santyityudamyu Vu̱jye̱ jaryiñu̱, jarichumu, jasityi sivaachara Ju̱denumu vuryeyadaju̱, si̱tenu Ju̱denu vichajomu jiryatiy saroriiyada yajiju̱ra, ne nijya̱mi̱ jomututa jvaachara dárya.

Darya sabayada Ju̱denu rirya̱jnutatya caserdótevyedara sa̱chara Ju̱denunijyu̱, rirya̱jvaryi jasi̱veda sanijyu̱ntiy, daryadantyi sa̱ma̱ jnutatya vu̱cyaserdóte nutyityu̱ra tara Ju̱denunijyu̱, vuryeyadaju̱.
Saryityi vichasara jirya mucadincha, ne saryi vicha caserdóte, mitya, jiryatiy jasiñuma riy caserdótevyeda bachavay raju̱, rirya̱tidye jnutatyasarara sa̱chara Ju̱denunijyu̱ su̱tedamusiy.

Riñi̱ ji̱ta jvaachara Ju̱denunijyu̱ nu̱tyu mitya jantyasara, nu̱tyu Jesús jvaarya jnutu nta, jiryatiy jarichumura. Daryani̱ su̱teda Ju̱denu ta̱riy siva Muyisésibe saroriiryu̱yadanumatiy donajatyara roriy Ju̱denujiju̱:

content.text: “Jatyi yivaachara darya ti̱ta̱ju̱ nu̱tyu ra̱ntyasara jiryatiy radyityadosiy musiquincha jíírya.”

content: Vu̱dyi ji̱ta siva Jesús jiryatiy sasaryera samiy jvaayadava̱ju̱ ruumusiy caserdótevyeda, daryasa̱ra̱ju̱ ravichasara samivya̱ju̱ Ju̱denu niquejadantiy, ramusityi sivaachara Jesús vuryeyadaju̱, ramusintyi saniquejada jiryatiy su̱teda Muyisésibemyusirya. Jirya saniquejada samivya̱ju̱ dárya, jiryatiy su̱teda yityamuju̱ra.
Netimyu̱ ne rani su̱tyeda tara munatya saniquejada, jiryatiy Muyisésibemyusirya, ne saryi va̱ta̱da tara niquejadana̱cho̱ ru̱bivaju̱.

content.text: “Ri̱tay si̱tenu jiryiva: Ra̱jti̱ rarunda jasityi ra̱jto̱tanirya vadi niquejada rusa̱ju̱ Irayénuveda, ti̱ta̱ju̱ jiryatiy judíyuveda daryi. Ne ra̱cha variy nu̱tyu rañiquejada jiryatiy ri̱teda rusa̱ju̱ rarundamu varityi ramyuteda Ejíptu mucadimusiryi. Jiryatimyu̱ ne rityuva̱churu̱yada daryaju̱ rañiquejadamu variy, rañi jiintye rirya̱jisiy variy, ri̱tay ji̱ta ray variy. Jiryatirya rañiquejada jiryatiy ra̱jtay rusa̱ju̱ Irayénuveda rarundavasirya: Ra̱numa barya rañiquejada rijechipiya̱jadamu, ra̱nu̱y variy rijechivyara. Ratyidye ra̱cha variy ru̱ndenuju̱, rityidye ra̱cha rañijya̱nvajyu̱ varintyidye. Ne rirya̱va̱ta datyadoda rityevay nu̱ñi ti̱quimusiy variy raynchiñu̱dayu, jiryatiy rirya̱datyasara ti̱ta̱ju̱ ray, deramimyusiy, ja̱myicha̱ra̱ju̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱. Ra̱jantyutya daryaju̱ va̱cha ruvaayadamusiyu, ne ra̱jachipityasarara rijyuuchuveda nu̱day, mitya.”

content: Darya su̱teda Vu̱jye̱ Ju̱denu ta̱riy, jiñijya̱nvay nchiy.
Ta̱riy niquejadata sadityadodara munatya jiñiquejada, jiryatiy su̱teda: Ra̱jto̱tanirya vadi niquejada ru̱bivaju̱. Ratiy ra̱rimyityuutyityi, ra̱caratyityi variy ru̱sijyu̱.
